mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_detail, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ids::text AS attachment_ids, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.mapping_id LIMIT 1

SELECT p.evaluation_year FROM input_period_settings p WHERE p.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND p.active_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN p.start_at AND p.end_at AND (p.organization_code IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.organization_code = p.organization_code AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' )) ORDER BY p.evaluation_year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings s WHERE s.management_item_code = #{code} AND s.evaluation_year = #{year} AND s.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND s.target_scope IN (#{organization}, 'ALL') AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{body.managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachments} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor}, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'COURSE_OPERATION' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by, request_id ) VALUES ('COURSE_OPERATION', #{id}, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '강좌 개설·운영 최초 입력', #{userId}, #{requestId})
